title: Binance OMS Toolkit: The First Institutional Exchange Solution for Trading Technology Providers
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is proud to announce the launch of Binance OMS Toolkit, the first institutional exchange solution built for Order Management System (OMS), Order and Execution Management System (OEMS), and trading technology providers serving institutional and professional trading clients. As institutional participation in digital assets continues to grow, OMS and trading technology providers have become critical infrastructure for how institutions access and interact with markets. Yet until now, exchanges have offered little beyond basic connectivity. Binance OMS Toolkit was built to change that, giving technology providers the exchange-level tools, insights, and service they need to better serve their clients and grow their business. What it Includes Deep Analytics:  Full visibility into end-client trading activity and order flow across the Binance platform, helping providers optimize client support and product access. Self-Service Integration:  Custom user tagging allows providers to segment and manage client accounts directly within the platform, without relying on Binance support for routine adjustments. Expanded Product Access:  OMS clients can offer access to Binance Spot and Futures markets through their system. Dedicated Institutional Support:  White-glove onboarding and support from Binance's VIP and Institutional team, ensuring a smooth integration and ongoing operational confidence. Binance OMS Toolkit is the next evolution of Binance Link and Trade, enhancing the existing partner toolkit with deep analytics and expanded integration capabilities. Getting Started with Binance OMS Toolkit Binance OMS Toolkit is available today for crypto-native and traditional market OMS and trading technology providers. Eligible providers can contact their Binance Institutional representative or  visit the OMS Toolkit page  to apply.
